model: Closed loop: one unique supplied account per virtual user; one outstanding request per virtual user; no think time during a stage.
limitations: End-to-end timings include the client, network, ngrok and backend; CPU, memory, DB and pool telemetry are unavailable.
A stage ends at its duration or request/budget limit. Results describe this bounded run, not a maximum capacity or SLA.
The caller supplies only existing test accounts; no account, password, role or content is modified.
No password, access token, refresh token, cookie, JWT subject or raw account body is written to the report.
Actual account privileges are observed at login; an admin-prefixed username does not establish admin authorization.
subjectProof: JWT uid values were compared only in memory and each usable token passed a server own-profile read. No subject value is recorded.
cleanupVerification: Accepted server logout responses only; no refresh replay or global device logout was performed in this load run.
sampleDefinition: Latency from fetch start through reading full response body. Percentiles use nearest rank for completed HTTP responses; transport errors/timeouts are counted separately. Stage RPS includes draining in-flight reads.
